text:
Marta: quick debrief from Valora Health onboarding call — they surfaced a mix of product asks and a renewal watch. pasting highlights (raw notes + link to transcript).
Derek: thanks. can you list the top 4 items we should triage?
Marta: TL;DR top priorities: 1) model pinning per-environment (they want to pin different model variants for staging vs prod and prevent autopromote) 2) embedding freshness / incremental update API (their content updates daily and reindexing full corpus is too slow) 3) team-level quotas + a lightweight approval workflow for quota increases 4) docs mismatch: Console examples still show `env` param as optional but their onboarding scripts fail without it. also they called out a renewal touchpoint — renewal decision in ~45 days and search freshness is a gating factor for expansion.
Samir: for #2 can you paste the specific failure or perf numbers? incremental vs full reindex concrete example helps.
Marta: pasted snippet and transcript link: https://app.redwood/meetings/valora-2026-10-14/transcript 
Marta: ```
action: index_delta(dataset=vh-products, delta_file=changes-2026-10-13.ndjson)
response: 202 Accepted
status: "queued"
later: index report: "processed 842 updates; reindexes needed: 0; freshness_lag: 36h"
// customer expected near-real-time delta application (<=5m) but observed multi-hour lag and occasional missing items
```
Olivia: that freshness lag is concerning. if they can't trust the index they can't use the product-search feature in production. marking as renewal-watch.
Derek: regarding #1 model pinning — isn't there already a `model_override` flag at route level?
Samir: there is, but customers want a non-ambiguous per-environment policy with immutability guarantees (no automatic fallback or silent switchover during infra deploys). they also want audit logs when a route's model is changed.
Marta: they asked for a simple UX: in Console, a dropdown for "staging/prod" model pin + toggle to prevent auto-fallback. small ask but important for regulated workflows.
Olivia: product note — audit logs for model changes + user who performed change + timestamp is a common enterprise ask. can we estimate a quick lift?
Samir: quick lift: expose existing config change events in audit index and surface last 10 changes in Console (1 sprint). full immutable pin + enforcement + policy eval ~3 sprints.
Derek: docs mismatch is likely a doc/regression. @Marta can you paste the failing snippet?
Marta: here is the script error they hit: ```
# onboarding script excerpt
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/routes \
  -d '{ "name": "vh-search", "model": "redwood-search-v2" }' 
# response: 400 { "error":"missing_param","param":"env" }
```
Marta: they expected `env` to default to `prod`; our docs show it as optional.
Olivia: action items and owners?
Derek: propose: (1) Samir to triage embedding delta pipeline + publish repro + mitigation ETA (owner: Samir) (2) Derek to open docs PR to clarify `env` param & Console examples (owner: Derek) (3) Olivia to create a product backlog item for per-environment model pinning + audit logs (owner: Olivia) (4) Marta to follow up with CSM on renewal comms and offer interim workaround (owner: Marta).
Marta: created FEED-40404 with notes and transcript attached: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-40404 — please add labels `onboarding`, `indexing`, `model-pinning`, `audit`, `renewal-watch`.
feedback-bot: FEED-40404 created and linked to Valora Health. Priority: P1.
Samir: repro in progress. initial hypothesis: delta ingestion queue backpressure + a transient worker timeout. short mitigation: increase worker concurrency for customer-specific queues and add delta-ack telemetry. ETA for mitigation: 4 business days. full fix (end-to-end low-latency delta API) estimate: 3 sprints. I'll post logs once repro completes.
Derek: I'll push a docs canary today to stop the `env` default mismatch and add a note about routing semantics.
Olivia: drafting the RFC for model-pinning UX + audit trail now. will include acceptance criteria from Valora: immutability toggle, explicit fallback opt-in, and event history export (CSV).
Marta: I'll offer Valora an interim workaround: a managed web-hook that notifies them when delta items are queued + a suggested prompt to surface SKU-like tokens for search. will send CSM email template.
Samir: posting initial logs in FEED-40404 now. aiming for a triage update EOD tomorrow.
Marta: thanks team :pray: — I'll keep renewal lead and CSM updated and schedule a 15m follow-up with Valora if we have concrete next steps after Samir's repro.
